description: Header file defining the UccServerImpl class, which implements a server for handling UCC commands over network sockets, including connection management, data parsing, and event handling within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: UccServerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a UCC server managing network connections, parsing, serialization, and event handling for UCC commands.

methods.name: UccServerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing server socket, parser, serializer, and event loop.

methods.name: ~UccServerImpl
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up UccServerImpl instance.

methods.name: send_reply
methods.description: Sends a reply string to a previously received UCC command.

methods.name: add_connection
methods.description: Adds a new client connection, registers event handlers.

methods.name: remove_connection
methods.description: Removes a client connection and optionally its event handlers.

methods.name: handle_connect
methods.description: Handles incoming connection requests on the server socket.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Reads data from a client socket and processes CMDU messages.

methods.name: handle_close
methods.description: Handles disconnection and errors on client sockets.
